judged_text: The migration interpolates the raw embeddable_hosts setting value into an unquoted-parameter SQL string ("INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"), so any stored host entry containing a single quote (the old setting accepted free-form lines) breaks the INSERT with a SQL syntax error and aborts the migration mid-way. The migration crashes during deploy after already deleting nothing (DELETE runs later) but leaves the site un-migrated on older hosts; on retry the embed_category join query can also return an empty set and nil['id'] raises NoMethodError on installs where embed_category's row holds '' (INNER JOIN on s.value = c.name matches nothing), making the migration non-restartable and blocking deploys.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`. Any `h` containing a single quote (or other special chars) will produce invalid SQL and abort the migration. Also, `category_id = execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` assumes the JOIN returns at least one row; if it returns none (e.g. `embed_category` set to '' or not matching any category name), `[0]` is nil and `nil['id']` will raise, making the migration fail on some existing installs.
